title: Comprehensible Japanese — Intermediate: 日本のお祭り (Japanese Festivals)
description: Comprehensible Japanese intermediate-level immersion content about Japan's vibrant matsuri culture. Explores summer festival traditions, the role of local shrines, Bon Odori dance, food stalls (屋台), and regional festivals like the Awa Odori. Natural speech pace at N3 level.
